items.title: What Could Power The Next Rally In McDonald's Stock
items.summary: A new beverage platform running at or above plan in each market it has entered offers McDonald's stock its clearest evidenced path up from a base left by a year of underperformance.

items.title: McDonald's Stock Down 19% in 6 Months: Is This a Buying Opportunity?
items.summary: MCD's U.S. traffic weakness and execution issues weigh on the stock, but international growth, beverages and a recovery plan offer upside.

items.title: China’s Favorite Budget Meal? Burgers
items.summary: Burgers are cheap, fast, and can cover the macros. What more could food delivery fiends want?

items.title: 3 Large-Cap Stocks to Target This Week
items.summary: Large-cap stocks have the power to shape entire industries thanks to their size and widespread influence. With such vast footprints, however, finding new areas for growth is much harder than for smaller, more agile players.

items.title: Anduril co-founder Palmer Luckey feuds with ex-Taco Bell CEO over McDonald's comments
items.summary: Anduril billionaire co-founder and mullet-wearing Palmer Luckey fired back at his onetime neighbor, Yum! Brands CEO Greg Creed.

items.title: McDonald’s Keeps Cratering: Why One Bullish Analyst Says 50% Gains Lie Ahead
items.summary: McDonald's has shed nearly 15% from its recent peak while a bold analyst just raised his target to levels most of Wall Street won't touch, and the question isn't whether the fundamentals support a recovery but whether the U.S. execution failure runs deeper than one bad quarter.

items.title: 1 Cash-Producing Stock for Long-Term Investors and 2 We Question
items.summary: A company that generates cash isn’t automatically a winner. Some businesses stockpile cash but fail to reinvest wisely, limiting their ability to expand.

items.title: 2 Profitable Stocks Worth Investigating and 1 We Avoid
items.summary: Even if a company is profitable, it doesn’t always mean it’s a great investment. Some struggle to maintain growth, face looming threats, or fail to reinvest wisely, limiting their future potential.
